provenance.untrackedPolicy: Source files are intent-to-add only in disposable after clone. The original repository index is unchanged.
provenance.scope: All changed source-code files in the captured worktree, complete sem declaration trees for those files, and every before/after graph edge touching those declarations. Other changed files keep their ordinary source diff.
provenance.edgeDeltaRule: Exact union of (fromEntity,toEntity,refType) raw graph tuples; present after only = added, before only = removed, both = unchanged.
provenance.entityRule: sem diff changeType supplies declaration status. No sem change is unchanged only when the same raw entity ID exists in both graphs; otherwise unclassified.
provenance.hierarchyRule: Graph parentId chains only; raw diff-only module-level changes have no inferred enclosing declaration.
provenance.displayRule: Present siblings retain new-source order. Removed siblings remain at their old position between old surviving siblings. Source excerpts align exact captured source-range bytes with difflib only for display; raw sem content is retained without claiming its trimming is original source.
limitations: sem graph name matching can report false cross-file targets. Those reported edges are retained unchanged.
Only .tsx, .ts, .py are captured. Generated JSON captures, CSS, package.json and documentation use the actual ordinary source renderer.
Calls and typeref are the native tool labels. A typeref is not presented as a call.
Diff-only orphan records are sem module-level changes, not synthesized declarations.
